mapper.sql: WK_USER_LRN_STS AS ( SELECT WS.SBJCT_ID , L.USER_ID , WS.LCTR_WKNO AS WKNO , NVL(MAX(L.PRGRT), 0) AS LRN_PRGRT , MAX(CASE WHEN L.PRGRT >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CMPTN_YN_NUM /* 저장된 주차별 학습상태를 기준으로 판정한다. CMPTN/기존 ATND는 화면상 출석으로 표시한다. */ , MAX( CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(L.LRN_STSCD)) IN ('CMPTN', 'ATND') THEN 3 WHEN UPPER(TRIM(L.LRN_STSCD)) = 'LATE' THEN 2 WHEN UPPER(TRIM(L.LRN_STSCD)) = 'ABSNT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS LRN_STS_ORD FROM TB_LMS_BYWKNO_USER_LRN_STS L JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL WS ON WS.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID WHERE WS.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} GROUP BY WS.SBJCT_ID, L.USER_ID, WS.LCTR_WKNO )

SBJCT_TERM_STS AS ( SELECT X.SBJCT_ID , CASE WHEN X.END_DTTM IS NOT NULL AND X.END_DTTM < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SMSTR_END_YN FROM ( SELECT S.SBJCT_ID /* 학기 종료 여부는 과목 강의종료일을 우선 적용하고, 없으면 학기기수 강의종료일을 기준으로 판정한다. */ , CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(S.SBJCT_LCTR_EDTTM, '^[0-9]{14}$') THEN S.SBJCT_LCTR_EDTTM WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(SC.SMSTR_CHRT_LCTR_EDTTM, '^[0-9]{14}$') THEN SC.SMSTR_CHRT_LCTR_EDTTM END AS END_DTTM FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT S LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE S.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ) X )
AND ( NVL(TS.SMSTR_END_YN, 'N') = 'Y' OR ( S.LCTR_WKNO_EYMD IS NOT NULL AND S.LCTR_WKNO_EYMD != '00000000' AND S.LCTR_WKNO_EYMD < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') ) )
CASE WHEN NVL(W.LRN_STS_ORD, 0) = 3 THEN 'ATND' WHEN NVL(W.LRN_STS_ORD, 0) = 2 THEN 'LATE' WHEN NVL(TS.SMSTR_END_YN, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 'ABSNT' ELSE 'NOTSTARTED' END

ASMT_TRGT AS ( SELECT ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_ID AS ROOT_ASMT_ID , TRGT_ASMT.ASMT_ID AS TARGET_ASMT_ID , TRGT.USER_ID , ROW_NUMBER() OVER( PARTITION BY ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_ID, TRGT.USER_ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRGT_ASMT.UP_ASMT_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END , TRGT_ASMT.ASMT_ID ) AS RN FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN_TRGT TRGT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT TRGT_ASMT ON TRGT_ASMT.ASMT_ID = TRGT.ASMT_ID AND TRGT_ASMT.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(TRGT_ASMT.DELYN,'N') = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT ROOT_ASMT ON ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_ID = NVL(TRGT_ASMT.UP_ASMT_ID, TRGT_ASMT.ASMT_ID) AND ROOT_ASMT.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(ROOT_ASMT.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND ROOT_ASMT.UP_ASMT_ID IS NULL AND ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_OYN = 'Y' JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC ON ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = TRGT_ASMT.SBJCT_ID AND ATNDLC.USER_ID = TRGT.USER_ID AND NVL(ATNDLC.AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N' AND ATNDLC.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' ), ASMT_TOT AS ( SELECT USER_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT ROOT_ASMT_ID) AS ASMT_TOT_CNT FROM ASMT_TRGT WHERE RN = 1 GROUP BY USER_ID ), ASMT_SUB AS ( SELECT T.USER_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT T.ROOT_ASMT_ID) AS ASMT_SBMSN_CNT FROM ASMT_TRGT T JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN S ON S.ASMT_ID = T.TARGET_ASMT_ID AND S.USER_ID = T.USER_ID AND NVL(S.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND S.SBMSN_DTTM IS NOT NULL WHERE T.RN = 1 GROUP BY T.USER_ID ), QA_STATS AS ( SELECT A.USER_ID , COUNT(CASE WHEN A.UP_ATCL_ID IS NULL AND NVL(A.DELYN,'N')='N' THEN 1 END) AS QA_REG_CNT , COUNT(CASE WHEN A.UP_ATCL_ID IS NOT NULL AND NVL(A.DELYN,'N')='N' THEN 1 END) AS QA_ANS_CNT FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL A JOIN TB_LMS_BBS B ON B.BBS_ID = A.BBS_ID WHERE B.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND B.BBS_TYCD = 'QNA' AND NVL(B.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(A.DELYN,'N') = 'N' GROUP BY A.USER_ID ), TALK_STATS AS ( SELECT C.USER_ID , COUNT(*) AS TALK_REPLY_CNT FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_CMNT C JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS_ATCL A ON A.DSCS_ATCL_ID = C.DSCS_ATCL_ID JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS D ON D.DSCS_ID = A.DSCS_ID WHERE D.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(D.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(C.DELYN,'N') = 'N' GROUP BY C.USER_ID ), QUIZ_BASE AS ( SELECT B.EXAM_BSC_ID , D.EXAM_DTL_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC B JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL D ON D.EXAM_BSC_ID = B.EXAM_BSC_ID WHERE B.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND B.EXAM_TYCD = 'QUIZ' AND NVL(B.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(B.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' AND NVL(D.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(D.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' ), QUIZ_TRGT AS ( SELECT DISTINCT QB.EXAM_BSC_ID , A.USER_ID FROM QUIZ_BASE QB JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC A ON A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(A.AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR G WHERE G.EXAM_DTL_ID = QB.EXAM_DTL_ID )
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT QB.EXAM_BSC_ID , M.USER_ID FROM QUIZ_BASE QB JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR G ON G.EXAM_DTL_ID = QB.EXAM_DTL_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR M ON M.TEAM_ID = G.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC A ON A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND A.USER_ID = M.USER_ID AND NVL(A.AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' ), QUIZ_TOT AS ( SELECT USER_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT EXAM_BSC_ID) AS QUIZ_TOT_CNT FROM QUIZ_TRGT GROUP BY USER_ID ), QUIZ_SUB AS ( SELECT QT.USER_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT QT.EXAM_BSC_ID) AS QUIZ_SBMSN_CNT FROM QUIZ_TRGT QT JOIN QUIZ_BASE QB ON QB.EXAM_BSC_ID = QT.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM T ON T.EXAM_DTL_ID = QB.EXAM_DTL_ID AND T.USER_ID = QT.USER_ID AND NVL(T.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND T.TKEXAM_CMPTNYN = 'Y' GROUP BY QT.USER_ID ), SRVY_TRGT AS ( SELECT DISTINCT S.SRVY_ID AS ROOT_SRVY_ID , S.SRVY_ID AS TARGET_SRVY_ID , A.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY S JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC A ON A.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID AND NVL(A.AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' WHERE S.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND S.SRVY_GBNCD = 'LCTR_SRVY' AND S.UP_SRVY_ID IS NULL AND NVL(S.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(S.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_SRVY SUB WHERE SUB.UP_SRVY_ID = S.SRVY_ID AND NVL(SUB.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(SUB.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' )
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT ROOT.SRVY_ID AS ROOT_SRVY_ID , SUB.SRVY_ID AS TARGET_SRVY_ID , M.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY ROOT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY SUB ON SUB.UP_SRVY_ID = ROOT.SRVY_ID AND NVL(SUB.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(SUB.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_TRGT G ON G.SRVY_ID = SUB.SRVY_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_ID = G.TEAM_ID AND T.TEAM_CPST_CMPTNYN = 'Y' JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR M ON M.TEAM_ID = G.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC A ON A.SBJCT_ID = ROOT.SBJCT_ID AND A.USER_ID = M.USER_ID AND NVL(A.AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' WHERE ROOT.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND ROOT.SRVY_GBNCD = 'LCTR_SRVY' AND ROOT.UP_SRVY_ID IS NULL AND NVL(ROOT.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(ROOT.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' ), SRVY_TOT AS ( SELECT USER_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT ROOT_SRVY_ID) AS SRVY_TOT_CNT FROM SRVY_TRGT GROUP BY USER_ID ), SRVY_SUB AS ( SELECT T.USER_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT T.ROOT_SRVY_ID) AS SRVY_SBMSN_CNT FROM SRVY_TRGT T JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_PTCP P ON P.SRVY_ID = T.TARGET_SRVY_ID AND P.USER_ID = T.USER_ID AND P.PTCP_EDTTM IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T.USER_ID ), DSCS_TRGT AS ( SELECT DISTINCT D.DSCS_ID AS ROOT_DSCS_ID , CASE WHEN D.DSCS_UNIT_TYCD = 'TEAM' THEN SUB.DSCS_ID ELSE D.DSCS_ID END AS TARGET_DSCS_ID , A.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_DSCS D JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC A ON A.SBJCT_ID = D.SBJCT_ID AND NVL(A.AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_GRP_ID = D.TEAM_GRP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR M ON M.TEAM_ID = T.TEAM_ID AND M.USER_ID = A.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS SUB ON SUB.UP_DSCS_ID = D.DSCS_ID AND SUB.TEAM_ID = T.TEAM_ID AND NVL(SUB.DELYN,'N') = 'N' WHERE D.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND D.UP_DSCS_ID IS NULL AND NVL(D.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND ( NVL(D.DSCS_UNIT_TYCD, 'GNRL') != 'TEAM' OR SUB.DSCS_ID IS NOT NULL ) ), DSCS_TOT AS ( SELECT USER_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT ROOT_DSCS_ID) AS DSCS_TOT_CNT FROM DSCS_TRGT GROUP BY USER_ID ), DSCS_SUB AS ( SELECT X.USER_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT X.ROOT_DSCS_ID) AS DSCS_SBMSN_CNT FROM ( SELECT T.USER_ID , T.ROOT_DSCS_ID FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_ATCL A JOIN DSCS_TRGT T ON T.TARGET_DSCS_ID = A.DSCS_ID AND T.USER_ID = A.USER_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND NVL(A.DELYN,'N') = 'N'
UNION ALL
SELECT T.USER_ID , T.ROOT_DSCS_ID FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_CMNT C JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS_ATCL A ON A.DSCS_ATCL_ID = C.DSCS_ATCL_ID JOIN DSCS_TRGT T ON T.TARGET_DSCS_ID = A.DSCS_ID AND T.USER_ID = C.USER_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND NVL(A.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(C.DELYN,'N') = 'N' ) X GROUP BY X.USER_ID ), EXAM_SCR AS ( SELECT T.USER_ID , MAX( CASE WHEN B.EXAM_GBNCD = 'EXAM_MID' AND NVL(D.REEXAMYN,'N') = 'N' AND B.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD = 'RLTM' THEN R.TOT_SCR END ) AS MID_LIVE_SCORE , MAX( CASE WHEN B.EXAM_GBNCD = 'EXAM_MID' AND NVL(D.REEXAMYN,'N') = 'Y' THEN R.TOT_SCR END ) AS MID_ALT_SCORE , MAX( CASE WHEN B.EXAM_GBNCD = 'EXAM_MID' AND NVL(D.REEXAMYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(B.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD,'X') != 'RLTM' THEN R.TOT_SCR END ) AS MID_ETC_SCORE , MAX( CASE WHEN B.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('EXAM_LST','EXAM_LST_TEAM') AND NVL(D.REEXAMYN,'N') = 'N' AND B.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD = 'RLTM' THEN R.TOT_SCR END ) AS FINAL_LIVE_SCORE , MAX( CASE WHEN B.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('EXAM_LST','EXAM_LST_TEAM') AND NVL(D.REEXAMYN,'N') = 'Y' THEN R.TOT_SCR END ) AS FINAL_ALT_SCORE , MAX( CASE WHEN B.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('EXAM_LST','EXAM_LST_TEAM') AND NVL(D.REEXAMYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(B.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD,'X') != 'RLTM' THEN R.TOT_SCR END ) AS FINAL_ETC_SCORE FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM T JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT R ON R.TKEXAM_ID = T.TKEXAM_ID AND R.USER_ID = T.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL D ON D.EXAM_DTL_ID = T.EXAM_DTL_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC B ON B.EXAM_BSC_ID = D.EXAM_BSC_ID WHERE B.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND B.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('EXAM_MID','EXAM_LST','EXAM_LST_TEAM') AND NVL(B.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(B.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' GROUP BY T.USER_ID )

ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY U.STDNT_NO ASC, U.USER_ID ASC) AS lineNo , COUNT(1) OVER() AS totalCnt , U.USER_ID AS userId , U.USERNM AS usernm , U.STDNT_NO AS stdntNo , D.DEPTNM AS deptnm , NVL(QA.QA_ANS_CNT, 0) AS qaAnsCnt , NVL(QA.QA_REG_CNT, 0) AS qaRegCnt , NVL(TK.TALK_REPLY_CNT, 0) AS talkReplyCnt , NVL(ASB.ASMT_SBMSN_CNT, 0) AS asmtSbmsnCnt , NVL(AT.ASMT_TOT_CNT, 0) AS asmtTrgtCnt , NVL(QS.QUIZ_SBMSN_CNT, 0) AS quizSbmsnCnt , NVL(QT.QUIZ_TOT_CNT, 0) AS quizTrgtCnt , NVL(SS.SRVY_SBMSN_CNT, 0) AS srvySbmsnCnt , NVL(ST2.SRVY_TOT_CNT, 0) AS srvyTrgtCnt , NVL(DS.DSCS_SBMSN_CNT, 0) AS dscsSbmsnCnt , NVL(DT.DSCS_TOT_CNT, 0) AS dscsTrgtCnt , ES.MID_LIVE_SCORE AS midLiveScore , ES.MID_ALT_SCORE AS midAltScore , ES.MID_ETC_SCORE AS midEtcScore , ES.FINAL_LIVE_SCORE AS finalLiveScore , ES.FINAL_ALT_SCORE AS finalAltScore , ES.FINAL_ETC_SCORE AS finalEtcScore , COALESCE(ES.MID_LIVE_SCORE, ES.MID_ALT_SCORE, ES.MID_ETC_SCORE) AS midScore , COALESCE(ES.FINAL_LIVE_SCORE, ES.FINAL_ALT_SCORE, ES.FINAL_ETC_SCORE) AS finalScore

SELECT A.SBJCT_ID AS sbjctId , A.SBJCT_YR AS sbjctYr , TRIM(A.SBJCT_SMSTR) AS sbjctSmstr , A.PROF_ID AS profId , A.CRCLMN_NO AS crclmnNo , A.SBJCTNM AS sbjctnm , A.DVCLAS_NO AS dvclasNo , A.DVCLAS_NCKNM AS dvclasNcknm , A.CRDTS AS crdts , A.WHOL_WK_CNT AS wkCnt , B.USERNM AS usernm , A.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AS smstrChrtId , A.USEYN AS useyn , ( SELECT LISTAGG(U2.USERNM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SA.SBJCT_ADM_SEQNO) FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM SA JOIN TB_LMS_USER U2 ON U2.USER_ID = SA.USER_ID WHERE SA.SBJCT_ID = A.SBJCT_ID AND SA.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD = 'TUT' ) AS tutor FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT A LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER B ON A.PROF_ID = B.USER_ID WHERE A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(A.DELYN,'N') = 'N'

WITH , , CURRENT_WK AS ( SELECT MAX(LCTR_WKNO) AS CURR_WKNO FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(DELYN, 'N') = 'N' AND LCTR_WKNO_SYMD IS NOT NULL AND LCTR_WKNO_SYMD <> '00000000' AND LCTR_WKNO_SYMD <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') ), STDNT_BASE AS ( SELECT U.USER_ID , U.USERNM , U.STDNT_NO , D.DEPTNM , NULL AS ENTRNS_YR , E.SCYR AS GRADE , SUM( CASE WHEN S.LCTR_WKNO IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN NVL(TS.SMSTR_END_YN, 'N') <> 'Y' THEN 0 WHEN W.WKNO IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN NVL(W.LRN_STS_ORD, 0) IN (2, 3) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ) AS ABSNCE_CNT , SUM( CASE WHEN S.LCTR_WKNO IS NOT NULL AND NVL(W.LRN_STS_ORD, 0) = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS ATND_CNT , SUM( CASE WHEN S.LCTR_WKNO IS NOT NULL AND NVL(W.LRN_STS_ORD, 0) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS LATE_CNT FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC E JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = E.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID CROSS JOIN CURRENT_WK CW JOIN SBJCT_TERM_STS TS ON TS.SBJCT_ID = E.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL S ON S.SBJCT_ID = E.SBJCT_ID AND NVL(S.DELYN, 'N') = 'N'
LEFT JOIN WK_USER_LRN_STS W ON W.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND W.SBJCT_ID = E.SBJCT_ID AND W.WKNO = S.LCTR_WKNO WHERE E.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND E.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' AND NVL(E.AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N'
GROUP BY U.USER_ID , U.USERNM , U.STDNT_NO , D.DEPTNM , E.SCYR
) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY S.STDNT_NO ASC, S.USER_ID ASC) AS lineNo , S.USER_ID AS userId , S.USERNM AS usernm , S.STDNT_NO AS stdntNo , S.DEPTNM AS deptnm , S.ENTRNS_YR AS entyR , S.GRADE AS scyr , S.ABSNCE_CNT AS absnCnt , S.ATND_CNT AS atndCnt , S.LATE_CNT AS lateCnt FROM STDNT_BASE S ORDER BY S.STDNT_NO ASC, S.USER_ID ASC

WITH , , CURRENT_WK AS ( SELECT MAX(LCTR_WKNO) AS CURR_WKNO FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(DELYN, 'N') = 'N' AND LCTR_WKNO_SYMD IS NOT NULL AND LCTR_WKNO_SYMD <> '00000000' AND LCTR_WKNO_SYMD <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') ), STDNT_BASE AS ( SELECT U.USER_ID , U.USERNM , U.STDNT_NO , D.DEPTNM , NULL AS ENTRNS_YR , E.SCYR AS GRADE , SUM( CASE WHEN S.LCTR_WKNO IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN NVL(TS.SMSTR_END_YN, 'N') <> 'Y' THEN 0 WHEN W.WKNO IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN NVL(W.LRN_STS_ORD, 0) IN (2, 3) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ) AS ABSNCE_CNT , SUM( CASE WHEN S.LCTR_WKNO IS NOT NULL AND NVL(W.LRN_STS_ORD, 0) = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS ATND_CNT , SUM( CASE WHEN S.LCTR_WKNO IS NOT NULL AND NVL(W.LRN_STS_ORD, 0) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS LATE_CNT FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC E JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = E.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID CROSS JOIN CURRENT_WK CW JOIN SBJCT_TERM_STS TS ON TS.SBJCT_ID = E.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL S ON S.SBJCT_ID = E.SBJCT_ID AND NVL(S.DELYN, 'N') = 'N'
LEFT JOIN WK_USER_LRN_STS W ON W.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND W.SBJCT_ID = E.SBJCT_ID AND W.WKNO = S.LCTR_WKNO WHERE E.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND E.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' AND NVL(E.AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N'
GROUP BY U.USER_ID , U.USERNM , U.STDNT_NO , D.DEPTNM , E.SCYR
) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STDNT_BASE

WITH
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY U.STDNT_NO ASC, U.USER_ID ASC) AS lineNo , U.USER_ID AS userId , U.USERNM AS usernm , U.STDNT_NO AS stdntNo , D.DEPTNM AS deptnm , NULL AS entyR , NVL(TO_CHAR(A.SCYR), '-') AS scyr , NVL(TO_CHAR(W.LRN_PRGRT), '0') AS prgrt FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC A JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = A.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN WK_USER_LRN_STS W ON W.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND W.SBJCT_ID = A.SBJCT_ID AND W.WKNO = #{wkNo} WHERE A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' AND NVL(A.AUDITYN, 'N') = 'N' AND CASE WHEN W.WKNO IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN NVL(W.LRN_STS_ORD, 0) IN (2, 3) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END = 1

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY X.sortDttm DESC) AS lineNo , X.sbmsnDttm , X.actionText , X.ipAddr FROM ( /* 응시완료 카운트(n/n)는 TB_LMS_TKEXAM 기준이므로 상세에도 완료 이력을 포함 */ SELECT NVL(T.TKEXAM_EDTTM, NVL(T.MOD_DTTM, T.REG_DTTM)) AS sortDttm , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NVL(T.TKEXAM_EDTTM, NVL(T.MOD_DTTM, T.REG_DTTM)),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS sbmsnDttm , '응시' AS actionText , NVL(( SELECT MAX(H2.TKEXAM_IP) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY H2.REG_DTTM) FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM_HSTRY H2 WHERE H2.EXAM_DTL_ID = T.EXAM_DTL_ID AND H2.USER_ID = T.USER_ID AND H2.TKEXAM_IP IS NOT NULL ), '-') AS ipAddr FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC B JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL D ON D.EXAM_BSC_ID = B.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM T ON T.EXAM_DTL_ID = D.EXAM_DTL_ID AND T.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE B.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{cntntsId} AND B.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(D.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(D.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' AND NVL(T.TKEXAM_CMPTNYN, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(T.DELYN, 'N') = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM_HSTRY HX WHERE HX.EXAM_DTL_ID = T.EXAM_DTL_ID AND HX.USER_ID = T.USER_ID AND HX.EXAM_HSTRY_GBNCD = 'EXAMPPR_SBMSN' )
UNION ALL
SELECT H.REG_DTTM AS sortDttm , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(H.REG_DTTM,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS sbmsnDttm /* 퀴즈 이력 코드를 학습현황 팝업 표시명으로 변환 */ , CASE H.EXAM_HSTRY_GBNCD WHEN 'REEXAM_STNG' THEN '재응시' WHEN 'EXAMPPR_GRNT' THEN '초기화' WHEN 'EXAMPPR_SBMSN' THEN '응시' /* 시험지 제출 */ WHEN 'EXAMPPR_TMP_SAVE' THEN '응시' /* 시험지 임시저장 */ WHEN 'TKEXAM_STRT' THEN '응시' /* 시험 응시 시작 */ ELSE NVL(CC.CDNM, H.EXAM_HSTRY_GBNCD) END AS actionText , NVL(H.TKEXAM_IP, '-') AS ipAddr FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC B JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL D ON D.EXAM_BSC_ID = B.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_HSTRY H ON H.EXAM_DTL_ID = D.EXAM_DTL_ID AND H.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CC ON CC.UP_CD = 'EXAM_HSTRY_GBNCD' AND CC.CD = H.EXAM_HSTRY_GBNCD WHERE B.EXAM_BSC_ID = #{cntntsId} AND B.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(D.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(D.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' AND H.EXAM_HSTRY_GBNCD IN ('EXAMPPR_SBMSN', 'EXAMPPR_GRNT', 'REEXAM_STNG') AND H.TKEXAM_HSTRY_ID = ( SELECT MAX(H3.TKEXAM_HSTRY_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY H3.REG_DTTM) FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM_HSTRY H3 WHERE H3.EXAM_DTL_ID = H.EXAM_DTL_ID AND H3.USER_ID = H.USER_ID AND H3.EXAM_HSTRY_GBNCD = H.EXAM_HSTRY_GBNCD ) ) X ORDER BY X.sortDttm DESC
